text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Dedicated cluster eu-west-1 — tenant `lento` elevated 5xx + timeouts (since 2024-10-22T15:07Z). Error rate spike: baseline 0.2% -> 11.8%. Paging on-call: @Zoe
Zoe: on it. Paging Sam and Eng-Platform. Are we seeing noisy-neighbor evictions or a routing blip?
Sam: seeing lots of kv-eviction logs, elevated inflight queue. Pod-level metrics show one tenant node consuming ~3x normal tokens/sec. Could be batch job from lente-internal.
Maria: can you paste the top logs?
Sam: here — snippet from gateway logs (truncated):
```
2024-10-22T15:06:02Z gateway[proxy-7] WARN upstream=127.0.0.1:5043 status=502 msg="failed to proxy" tenant=lento req_id=abc123
2024-10-22T15:06:03Z runtime[host-11] ERROR kvcache eviction high watermark tenant=lento evictions=1890
2024-10-22T15:06:07Z runtime[host-12] WARN request timeout upstream=runtime-12 timeout=30s tenant=lento
```
Zoe: thx. Gateway 502/504 + runtime eviction noise = noisy neighbor/kv thrash pattern. Leon, can you confirm if Lento kicked off a large inference batch?
Leon: pinged Lento infra—no reply yet. Dev dashboard shows a spike of long-running streaming requests from a single API key starting ~15:04Z. Could be a customer-side job.
Alex: customer-impact? is traffic being dropped or queued? Any 429s?
Sam: not 429s — mainly 502/504 and internal timeouts. p95 latency for the tenant up from 320ms -> 2.9s. Some other tenants on same pool also seeing 5xx tail increasing (noisy neighbor spillover).
Zoe: mitigation proposals: 1) apply per-tenant soft rate-limit for lento, 2) shift lento traffic to fallback variant (lower-capacity but isolated), 3) temporarily scale dedicated pool by +2 nodes. Thoughts?
Mike: quick wins: we can flip routing weight for tenant `lento` to fallback in console (route weight rollouts) and abort burst routing for that tenant. Scaling takes ~8-12min.
Maria: do we have safe rollback plan? If we shift and ctor fails, we can revert in console and reenable burst.
eng-platform: recommend doing the route weight change first (fast), then rate-limit. If route change doesn't stabilize within 5 minutes, start scale-up. We'll stand by for `kubectl` commands.
Zoe: Alex / Irene, pls prep customer comms: "We observed increased errors and are isolating your traffic — this may affect throughput for a few minutes while we stabilize."
Irene: on it. Sending a short status note to Lento CSM and asking for any scheduled jobs.
Sam: performing route weight patch now. Command: ```/console routes set-weight --tenant lento --variant fallback --weight 100```
Sam: executed. Observing metrics...
(2m) Sam: 5xx rate dropped from 11.8% -> 3.4%, p95 latency down to 1.2s. Still elevated but improving.
Zoe: good. Apply soft rate-limit to be safe: set tenant max-concurrency = 50 (was 250).
Sam: applied per-tenant concurrency cap. Immediate drop to 1.0% 5xx, p95 ~680ms.
Mike: scheduling node scale up as precautionary — started; expected ready ~+9min.
Leon: Lento responded: "we're running a backfill batch, will pause if needed". They paused heavy job.
Alex: updating support ticket: impact window ~15:04Z - 15:20Z. Customer-facing: transient errors, no data loss.
Zoe: monitoring for 15 more minutes, then we'll start remediation plan. Any persistent root cause signals?
Maria: cluster-level metrics show KV hit-rate drop and eviction spikes aligned with the tenant spike. Looks like tenant workload pattern caused cache thrash and backend timeouts. Need long-term: tenant isolation or smarter cache partitioning.
eng-platform: created follow-up infra task INFRA-4982 to add tenant-level eviction metrics and automated QoS.
Irene: sent message to Lento: "We've isolated your traffic and reduced the errors. Please confirm if you paused the batch; our team will follow up with an RCA." (customer replied: "paused, thanks").
Zoe: good. Summary: applied route fallback + per-tenant cap; scale up initiated as safety. Impact reduced from ~12% -> ~1% 5xx. No SLA breach reported yet but close call.
Sam: collecting full traces and a timeline, will attach to incident ticket.
Maria: action items: 1) ENG-PLATFORM to implement tenant QoS experiment (INFRA-4982), 2) Runtime to add eviction/kv metrics per-tenant (RUNTIME-2027), 3) Support to confirm with customer and keep incident ticket updated.
Zoe: leaving note for on-call handoff: @eng-platform please own next 2 hours of watch, @Sam please run postmortem draft, @Irene follow up with Lento about scheduled heavy jobs.
eng-platform: acknowledged — taking post-incident watch.
Sam: attaching pprof snippet and flamegraph link (internal): https://perf.internal/reports/lento/1748501234
Zoe: closing thread for active paging. We'll reopen if error rate creeps above 2% again.
incident-bot: incident created: INCT-2024-2041 assigned to eng-platform, severity: S2, start_ts=1748501234
Alex: adding note to ticket: mitigation performed and customer paused job.
Irene: final customer note sent: "We implemented a temporary mitigation and are doing an RCA. We'll share findings by EOD." :white_check_mark:
Zoe: thanks everyone — great coordination.
